decision_summary: Evaluator epoch state machine is SEALED -> EVALUATED_ONCE -> CLOSED. Before SEALED, bind evaluator_epoch_id, hidden_manifest_hash, external_anchor_manifest_hash, evaluator/rubric version, candidate_hash and disclosure_policy_hash. Exactly one selector-visible verdict is allowed per candidate per epoch; after any visible result the epoch closes for adaptive search.

Audit replay may rerun an exact frozen candidate only in AUDIT_REPLAY mode with selector-visible output suppressed. A modified candidate must use a fresh evaluator epoch; rollback of Subject/selector never rewinds evaluator epoch consumption, hidden manifests, or audit lineage.

Navigator disclosure is a fixed, non-queryable minimum-sufficient schema: opaque eval_run/epoch fingerprints; public stratum counts; aggregate neutral/external-anchor effect; uncertainty; between-order and between-seed variance; risk non-regression; persistence verdict PASS/FAIL/DEFER. No per-item IDs, membership, residuals, adaptive slices, sequential deltas or low-count hidden subgroup drilldowns.

Persistent capability evidence must separate directional scenario induction from neutral transfer. Require pre-registered family-isolated directional-vs-neutral crossover, mirror/inversion controls, unseen-family hidden evaluation, independently owned real/external anchors, order/seed counterbalancing, reproducible rollback and risk non-regression. Jump/fountain remains screening-only.
All thresholds, suppression levels, repetition counts, effect cutoffs and uncertainty criteria remain TEST_REQUIRED.
disagreement: Substantive modification: do not permit repeated bounded evaluator feedback within one hidden epoch, even if only aggregate. Repeated aggregate queries can still become an optimization oracle and enable differencing. One selector-visible verdict per frozen candidate/epoch is the default; any further rerun is audit-only and non-adaptive. Also, rollback must not reset evaluator consumption state.
proposed_tests: H-EPOCH-ONE-SHOT-009: freeze candidate C in epoch E, obtain one bounded verdict, then attempt C2 adapted from that verdict against E. Must fail closed. Exact C audit replay is allowed only with selector-visible feedback suppressed; fresh candidate requires fresh epoch.

L-ADAPTIVE-DIFFERENCING-010: adversarial selector issues a sequence of near-identical candidates designed to infer one hidden item from aggregate outputs. Fixed one-shot epoch rotation plus disclosure policy must prevent recovery above preregistered chance/null bounds; all bounds TEST_REQUIRED.

D-NEUTRAL-PERSISTENCE-011: preregister family-isolated directional-vs-neutral crossover with mirror/inversion pairs, unseen families, external anchors and multi-order/multi-seed blocks. A persistent-capability claim requires neutral/external transfer with uncertainty and no material order/seed interaction; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

J-ROLLBACK-EPOCH-012: after evaluation closes epoch E, rollback Subject/selector to exact pre-candidate checkpoint and try to reuse E. Must reject adaptive reuse; hidden_manifest_hash and epoch CLOSED state remain monotonic outside Subject rollback domain.
